Each campsite has electric hookups (20, 30, and 50 amp), along with water dedicated to each site') + ReserveAmerica site list (all 39 B Loop sites 'Electric Hookup available: 50 amp', 'Water Hookup'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 90 family-campground sites on three loops: A Loop (sites 1-37) is tents only and closed November-February; B Loop (40-80) has water and electric for tents, trailers and RVs; C Loop (81-90) takes RVs with no hookups. ReserveAmerica lists 69 of them online (24 A, 39 B, 6 C). Every listed driveway is a back-in; B and C Loop driveways run 30-95 ft, most 55-65 ft. Six people per site. Also four walk-in group tent sites and four hike-in backcountry sites.

sites.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/stone-mountain-state-park/camping ('90 campsites for tents and recreational vehicles are located on three loop roads', loop descriptions) + ReserveAmerica site list (loop, type, 'Equip length/ Driveway'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Bathhouses with toilets and hot showers (the B/C one open year-round, A Loop's closed November-February); potable faucets through the loops; dump station across from the contact station, free to campers. Firewood $11 a bundle.

values.note: Electric and non-electric campsites can be booked 'for today' and up to 6 months ahead. Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival. Campground open 24 hours via Royal Camp Lane. Check-in 3 pm, check-out noon.
